scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./packages/api run build && pnpm --filter ./packages/frontend run build && pnpm run worker:build
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run start:services
scripts.start:services: concurrently -n api,worker,fe -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter ./packages/api run start:prod" "pnpm run worker:run" "pnpm --filter ./packages/frontend run preview"
scripts.start:backend: XQECZ_SYNC_DEPS=1 node scripts/sync-deps.mjs; NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=512 concurrently -n api,worker -c blue,green "cd packages/api && node dist/main" "packages/worker/xqecz-worker"
scripts.worker:build: cd packages/worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o xqecz-worker ./cmd/server/
